## Atlético-MG plan rotated side for Cruzeiro derby; see line-up

Atlético-MG are expected to field a mix of regular starters and reserves against Cruzeiro this Thursday (29) at 7:30 p.m. (Brasília time) at Arena MRV in Belo Horizonte, in the 33rd round of the Brazilian Championship Série A. [...] ### Tomás Cuello and Fred expected to remain sidelined

Forward Tomás Cuello, who suffered a rib injury, is expected to remain out of the team. Defensive midfielder Fred is also unlikely to feature in the derby as he recovers from a left hamstring injury.

Atlético-MG also have other absentees, including center-back Vitor Hugo, who is suspended after receiving his third yellow card against Flamengo. These absences limit Eduardo Domínguez's options when selecting his team. [...] ### What is Atlético-MG's expected lineup for the derby against Cruzeiro?

Coach Eduardo Domínguez is expected to field the following Atlético-MG lineup: Everson; Natanael, Léo Duarte, Vitão and Kauã Pascini; Alan Franco, Kevin Castaño, Alexsander, Igor Gomes and Ángelo Preciado; Reinier.

## New competition format

The top four teams in each group will advance to the quarterfinals. From that stage onward, ties will be played over two legs, home and away.

Another change will be the return of a two-legged final. Unlike in 2026, when the title was decided in a single match, the 2027 final will also feature home and away legs. [...] ·
